mockup_locked_by: founder (delegated — chip-row state matrix, no new visual language)
notes: D1: doSearch had no stale-response guard; with a cold-starting backend a slow earlier request could repaint the unfiltered list over a newer filtered one, which is what made the city filter look dead. The city SQL itself was verified correct against production first (vijayawada 6, nellore 16, hyderabad 3). D2: tier chips were hidden at count 0, so selecting a tier removed the others and stranded the user. D3: counts were page-scoped and wrong (header 69 vs All 50; Nano 10 vs a true 13). Fixed by moving the tier condition last, adding a GROUP BY tier facet query that excludes the tier filter, returning meta.tier_counts, and always rendering every chip with zero-match tiers disabled rather than removed. NOTE: any new filter must be added BEFORE the tier block or it will be silently excluded from the facet counts. Not fixed: 37 of 73 creators have no city on record, so city filtering remains aggressive by construction. Production-impacting (Render + Vercel): explicit founder go required before push.
